required_fixes.issue: Fifty-three of the 60 replacements are concrete and authorable, but seven strategy-choice contracts still omit an input needed to produce their requested checks. Difference Equations never defines x[n] for the requested length-6 comparison. Parametric Spectral Estimation gives no AR(2) poles, record length, innovation variance, or seed. The z-Transform task gives the near-cancelled design but not the benign design it also asks the learner to audit. Finite-Word Realizations gives no coefficients or complete design specification for its eighth-order elliptic filter. Minimum-Phase Structures identifies no 255-tap response or reproducible generator. Wavelet Banks gives neither channel count/prototype for the uniform bank nor wavelet family/level count for the dyadic bank. The terminal Streaming Audio task omits the FIR length needed to compute overlap-save valid ranges and does not define the channel impairment needed for its EVM check.
required_fixes.required_change: Supply the missing literal sequence, coefficients, poles, lengths, seeds, bank definitions, filter length, and impairment parameters (or name a precise bundled artifact containing them). Keep the present method pairs, selection cues, and requested comparison artifacts.

advisories.message: Impulse Response and Convolution remains a plausible 36-minute polished opener, but its three first-exposure concepts plus identification demo should still be piloted for C3 difficulty.
The selected audio, ECG, oboe/PARSHL, and quantization artifacts retain explicit permission or rights-cleared fallback gates; publication clearance remains outstanding where stated.

All 15 demo specs retain a task, numerical target, and falsification behavior. Initial presets, alive-on-arrival state, sub-200 ms response, accessibility, mobile behavior, and implementation size remain implementation-stage checks.
